title: InformationClass (catalogue instance schema)
description: Catalogue-instance projection of the metamodel InformationClass entity. The normative field set is defined by the metamodel schema; this file mirrors it and adds only the catalogue-instance layer (classification axes, governance, cross-catalogue references). Do not widen a normative enum here to accept a value the metamodel does not define: fix the record instead. A catalogue that diverges from the metamodel is a second source of truth.

id.description: OpenDEAM-local identifier. The metamodel pattern is the general ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z0-9-]+$; this catalogue narrows it to the InformationClass entity namespace so a record cannot be filed under another entity's identifier form.

external_references.description: Identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEAM id (E004).

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity axis. One value per record; the classification axes are the admission test.

regulatory_regime.description: Regulatory-regime axis. A record may be governed by more than one regime.

handling_requirements.description: Catalogue-instance layer. Mandatory controls implied by the classification.

retention.description: Catalogue-instance layer. Retention rule or schedule the record's custodians apply.

governance.description: Catalogue-instance layer. Ownership and review state.

relationships.description: Cross-catalogue crosswalk (CR-IC-CAT-05). Per FOUNDATIONS D-6 the dea:maps-to crosswalk is recorded on the mapped entity's side; this field carries the inverse (dea:mapped-from) for cataloguing and query, and is validated by Gate 8.

mapped_from.description: Canonical ids of entities in other catalogues that map to this class via dea:maps-to.
